question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that presence in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
That presence is the object of meditation.
Its range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that presence in every place as pervading all levels from Shiva to Avici.
